BiblicalUsage: Charey-yowniym is dove's dung, and it appears twice, both times in a siege. In Samaria the famine was so great that the fourth part of a cab of dove's dung sold for five pieces of silver, and Rabshakeh taunted the men on the wall that they would eat their own dung and drink their own water with the besiegers.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the word is there to show how far a siege can bring a city: when even dung is sold for silver, the famine has done its work.
